description: Conditional coverage with explicit excluded middle and zero Lean axioms; no exclusivity claim. Extract an unpreceded moved-potency witness from the existing Night reading. Excluded middle first decides whether it has a mover in act in the same respect, then whether a selected such mover is the potency itself. If distinct, the Night witness already excludes its simple priority. This covers possible repairs of the existing GENERATION-FROM-NIGHT-REFUTED argument, not serious worldviews by mere labels; its three omission models witness the corresponding branches. No source attributes this classification, no horn is established unconditionally, and no root premise closes.
